**Describe the feature**
What would you like to add or change?

**Use case**
Why is this useful? What problem does it solve?

**Proposed implementation (optional)**
If you have ideas on how to implement it — new graph layer, new physics model, new UI control, etc.

**Mockup / reference**
Screenshots, sketches, or links to similar features in other apps.
